amendments.name: observedHeadingIds
amendments.reason: RICH-03: replace the persistent heading-ID set with an element-identity WeakSet. When React replaces a heading during a streaming update, the new element must be observed even when its stable anchor ID is unchanged; the TOC ID and source heading contract remain unchanged.

amendments.name: observeHeadings
amendments.reason: RICH-03: observe heading DOM element identity rather than only anchor IDs, so a streaming React replacement with the same stable ID is re-observed. This changes observation bookkeeping only; heading IDs and navigation targets are preserved.

amendments.name: scrollToHeading
amendments.reason: RICH-03: preserve the same target and sticky offset while respecting prefers-reduced-motion; only scroll animation mode changes from unconditional smooth to smooth-or-auto.
